learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, project, and research and their limitations in their field of expertise.
Practical application of engineering: Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects, and conduct research specific to their field.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology, and engineering processes and their limitations in their field of expertise.
Practical application of engineering: Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.

Practical application of engineering: General ideas about economic, organizational, and management issues (such as project management, risk, and change management) in the industrial and business context.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers and people from other disciplines.
Continuous training: Ability to keep up to date with new developments in science and technology.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, arguing and justifying each one, and making correct use of language, in writing.

syllabus_topics: Execution of tasks assigned by the company

assessment_methods.method: Technical capacity, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation submitted, technical presentation and defense
Observation of student participation and attitude in the proposed training activities

assessment_rules: The course will have continuous evaluation based on meetings with tutors. With the feedback provided in these meetings and partial submissions, students must improve the quality of their work, activity, report, and presentation until the final evaluation. If the course is not passed or the final report is not submitted, the course must be repeated.
